label: TEST: CX-8 rig and local test stack only. Not an owner decision and not a product default.

PROTOCOL_REPRESENTATION_VERSION.note: TEST version of the representation a wallet signs before its first signing action. Blank in production refuses compliance.representation_unset.

PROTOCOL_REPRESENTATION_TEXT.value: TEST representation, not counsel's wording: I am not located in, or acting for anyone in, a region where this service is not available.
PROTOCOL_REPRESENTATION_TEXT.note: TEST wording only. Counsel writes the real text; blank in production refuses compliance.representation_unset.

PROTOCOL_AMM_FEE_TIERS_BPS.note: TEST fee tiers (0.05%, 0.30%, 1.00%) the new-pool form offers on the local TEST chain. Blank in production refuses amm.fee_tiers_unset and the form offers only a custom fee.

PROTOCOL_SWAP_SLIPPAGE_BPS.note: TEST slippage ceiling (3%) for the swap journeys on the local TEST chain. Blank in production refuses protocol.swap_slippage_unset.

PROTOCOL_SWAP_QUOTE_TTL_SECONDS.note: TEST quote lifetime for the swap journeys. Blank in production refuses protocol.swap_settings_unset.

PROTOCOL_SWAP_CONFIRMATIONS.note: TEST confirmations before a swap reads filled, on the local TEST chain. Blank in production refuses protocol.swap_settings_unset.

PROTOCOL_WALLET_SESSION_TTL_SECONDS.note: TEST lifetime of a wallet session that opens the address book. Blank in production refuses protocol.wallet_session_unset. The session secret is not in this file: the local stack derives a TEST-labelled one from its own secrets.json.

PROTOCOL_WALLET_SESSION_ORIGINS.note: TEST: the local stack's customer origins that wallet sign-in messages are written for. Blank in production refuses protocol.wallet_session_unset.

PROTOCOL_ADDRESS_BOOK_MAX_CONTACTS.note: TEST maximum contacts in one wallet's address book. Blank in production refuses protocol.address_book_max_contacts_unset.

PROTOCOL_WALLET_GROUPS_MAX.note: TEST maximum wallet groups per wallet. Blank in production refuses protocol.wallet_groups_max_unset.

PROTOCOL_GAS_PERCENTILES.note: TEST percentiles of the last blocks' priority fees for the Slow, Normal and Fast network fee levels and the gas tracker. Blank in production refuses protocol.gas_percentiles_unset.

PROTOCOL_GAS_HISTORY_BLOCKS.note: TEST count of recent blocks the fee levels are read from. Blank in production refuses protocol.gas_percentiles_unset.

PROTOCOL_SWAP_MAX_FEE_PER_GAS_WEI.note: TEST fee cap (100 gwei per gas) on the local TEST chain: the most any fee level or custom fee may offer. Blank in production refuses protocol.swap_fee_cap_unset.

PROTOCOL_PRICE_USD_TOKENS.note: TEST USD on the local TEST chain, counted as one dollar for the swap form's prices. Blank in production refuses protocol.price_settings_unset.

PROTOCOL_PRICE_MIN_RESERVE_USD.note: TEST reliability filter: a pool must hold 1,000 TEST USD worth on its priced side for its price to show. Blank in production refuses protocol.price_settings_unset.

PROTOCOL_TOKENS_QUOTE_TOKEN.note: LOCAL TEST ONLY, not an owner decision: TEST Token B on the local TEST chain, the token the token pages state prices and volumes in. Blank in production refuses protocol.tokens_quote_unset.

PROTOCOL_LISTING_CHALLENGE_TTL_SECONDS.note: TEST lifetime of a contract ownership challenge. Blank in production refuses protocol.listing.challenge_ttl_unset.

PROTOCOL_FEE_RELAY_URL.note: The TEST relayer stand-in local-test-chain.mjs serves: it sends a signed fee-token swap and pays its gas in TEST ETH. The relay contract's address (PROTOCOL_FEE_RELAY_ADDRESS) comes from the seeded TEST chain, like the pool factory. Blank in production refuses protocol.fee_relay_unset.

PROTOCOL_FEE_RELAY_GAS_LIMIT.note: TEST gas a relayed fee-token swap is priced for and sent with. Blank in production refuses protocol.fee_relay_unset.

PROTOCOL_TX_FEE_BUMP_BPS.note: TEST: a speed-up or cancel raises both fee fields of the pending transaction by 20% (RC-dex-protocol-01, J-dex-protocol-04 #8). Blank in production refuses protocol.fee_bump_unset.

PROTOCOL_TX_FEE_CEILING_WEI.note: TEST: a speed-up or cancel is never built above 100 gwei per gas (RC-dex-protocol-01). Blank in production refuses protocol.fee_ceiling_unset.
